eesel (#5), joyz.ai, denser.ai and quickchat.ai rank with comparison/guide pages; the SERP mixes customer-facing and internal-wiki intent
Fin AI Agent is $0.99 per outcome on every plan; Help Scout AI Answers is $0.75 per resolution (helpscout.com/pricing), so incumbent help-desk AI is metered per answer
DocsBot Personal $49/mo includes 5k source pages and 5k AI credits; Chatbase Hobby $32/mo (yearly) has 700 credits; Docapta's $39 with 50 pages/500 questions is weaker on limits
Sampled small-SaaS docs sitemaps: Buttondown 281, Tally 197, Simple Analytics 116, Kit 411 help pages; all exceed Docapta's 50-page cap

Docusaurus showcase lists 32 commercial product docs sites (product tag, not opensource) as a first outreach list to screen
